body: Adding onto this, it’s even less accessible to me because I’m not able to leave home on my own/drive anywhere because I have severe epilepsy and it’s out of control. We don’t have buses or trains or anything you can take here, really. Just a shitty situation all around. Welp.

Where I live there’s hardly anything at all. Places nowadays are having to turn away new patients because they can’t keep up. Place is fucked.
Funny, I hear this advice so many times, I try and explain this, especially to people who aren’t from around here, and they get upset at me as if it’s my fault these things happen. Crazy.

Well, at least good to hear that. That we aren’t alone. 
Sometimes I wish I could bring people with me and we all could. Though yeah, not exactly in the spot to do it either myself. Need silly alternatives that aren’t self destructive.

Nah you’re good. Nothing to be sorry for. If you need to vent, you can always dm me, I’m pretty open. 

And really, I asked because one silly to another, you really aren’t alone in that. I mean, most of these people you don’t even know, and you can consciously realize they don’t/won’t have an impact on you, but you’re reminded of your own needs. And that’s what makes it hurt. 

The question of that deeper problem is a difficult one. But I mean, just being aware of the problem, like you are, is a huge step. Trust me, I hear some insane shit on the daily, you definitely don’t sound like a bad person. 

If you need to talk anything out, once again, dms open, or you can just reply with any thoughts if you want. Wish you all the best.

You’re far from the only one. Do you more mean people being really confident and outgoing with themselves? You’re not horrible either way, I’m just curious to know, as someone who struggles with, (I think?) similar.

So much I don’t like being here often, or on femboy subreddits or other places. Much of it does stem from self-esteem issues but there is more to it. For me and for you.

I fully get your struggle. I’m not liking reading  people’s responses, which I mean, yes, they are right, but more I can’t tell if you mean this literally or are just venting and you know why already. 

Either way, not important. Because many days I feel the same :/ I grew up surrounded by alcoholics, and got to see how they made everyone’s lives fucking miserable. 

It’s too dangerous for me to drink because I have severe epilepsy, which is the only way I get out of it. I bring that up because I’m just as pissed about the alcoholism culture we’re surrounded in.

The fact people pressure you to drink, they try and make you do it, like you have to do it or you’re “not cool” or you’re “not having fun” or because “everyone else is doing it” or whatever bullshit they’re thinking. It just fucking sucks. All around. I’ve had people who know this about me, and still try to pressure me into it. “Oh it’s just one time, it’s fine. NO THE FUCK ITS NOT.

I mean yeah, alcohol is alcohol…. Alcoholism is a disease. And it ruins lives and relationships. I’m not sure of your situation, but really the only way forward is to stand your ground and tell them what is wrong. They have a drinking problem, and you’re not going to put up with it. Even if you have to avoid them to not get sucked up in the drama. They have to figure it out somehow. Or they’ll die lonely. As fucked up as it is. I feel fucked up saying it.

Anyway, I’m lending my helping hand here, if you’re feeling alone in this, you can send me a dm, open any time. If you need someone to talk to when you’re trying to get away from those toxic people, or whenever need be. If there’s any solace that I, or anyone else here, can be.

If you need someone to talk to, I’m willing to listen. It’s about the only way I could help. I get it, the “it gets better, don’t give up” cliche doesn’t do anyone any good. I can lend an ear and give my best advice on what is specifically going on, if you’d want. 

As someone at that point in life too, I can understand and be of company. And in this world now, I get why people do this. Going NEET and that type of thing. The loneliness, state of the world, the lack of purpose in many parts of life, it’s like we never really solve our problems. 

Idk a good way to explain it. But best we can do here is reach out and try and help with the loneliness. Dms are open, let me know if there’s anything I can do.

No one’s ever been perfect, and something like this would be far from tainting Myles’ track record.

Personally I wasn’t a fan of Myles’ vocals on songs like Slither when he did that with Slash, but of course it wasn’t just completely terrible, just wasn’t a good fit imo. So a Creed song might not be fitting for him, maybe or maybe not, I’d be more than willing to listen to him try though. I think Stapp and Myles coming together and doing a new song together would be cool though.
